ordering_details.rationale: DispatchDomainEventsJob has tries=6 + backoff [1,5,15,60,300]. A failed dispatch of Event N can be re-attempted up to ~6.4 min after Event N+1 succeeds, so subscriber may observe N+1 before N. No per-aggregate sequencing queue. The HasDomainEvents trait collects multiple events per save() and dispatches them in id-ascending order inside DB::afterCommit (HasDomainEvents.php:55-60) — but each is queued onto the SAME 'high' lane, where workers consume independently.
ordering_details.creation_time_ordering: domain_events.id is auto-increment + HasDomainEvents persists then dispatches in id-asc order — so initial enqueue order matches creation order. However Laravel queue with multiple workers (numprocs=2-4+ in QUEUE_TOPOLOGY.md §3.1-3.2) and per-row retries can interleave across aggregates.
ordering_details.broadcast_layer_ordering: Pusher/Soketi channels honor in-order delivery PER PUBLISHER on a given channel — but multi-worker dispatch breaks single-publisher assumption. Subscribers must NOT rely on absolute order across events.
ordering_details.claim_serialization: Phase 1 atomic claim under row lock (DispatchDomainEventsJob.php:54-86) — lockForUpdate + dispatched_at guard prevents double-broadcast of the SAME row. No global ordering, only per-row exactly-once-attempt semantics.
ordering_details.subscriber_contract: Subscribers (POS/KDS/Kiosk) must reconcile by event_type + aggregate_id + payload timestamps; absolute outbox order is NOT promised by V1 LOCAL pipeline.
ordering_details.high_priority_lane_vs_default: Only 'high' for DispatchDomainEventsJob — guaranteed served before 'notifications' (FCM) and 'default' by --queue=high,notifications,default worker ordering (QUEUE_TOPOLOGY.md §2). FCM cannot starve outbox. No starvation in reverse: outbox cannot block FCM because lanes are independent pools (numprocs >= 2 each in SMB topology).

queue_worker_caveat_local.drift: Local .env uses redis but docs/operations/QUEUE_TOPOLOGY.md prescribes 'database'. Both drivers are correct topologies — the doc shows the supervisor command for 'database'. V1 LOCAL Le Cayenne: this is fine because $this->onQueue('high') resolves on whichever connection is active. No P0/P1 impact; doc/env reconciliation is a V1.0.X doc-polish backlog item.
queue_worker_caveat_local.production_required: PRODUCTION_SETUP.md:60 prescribes systemd ExecStart with --queue=high,default — slightly older form than the QUEUE_TOPOLOGY.md SSOT (missing 'notifications' lane). Triple-doc drift across DEPLOYMENT_GUIDE_V1.md / DEPLOIEMENT.md / REALTIME_SETUP.md / QUEUE_WORKER_SETUP.md / PRODUCTION_SETUP.md / QUEUE_TOPOLOGY.md — SSOT is QUEUE_TOPOLOGY.md per NEW-03.

queue_restart_post_deploy: php artisan queue:restart documented in QUEUE_TOPOLOGY.md §7 but no Kernel.php scheduler triggers it — assumed handled by deploy pipeline (supervisor or systemd unit reload)

scheduled_crons_non_conflicting_analysis: All four mission-specified lanes use ->onOneServer() + ->withoutOverlapping() + ->runInBackground() + ->appendOutputTo(distinct log files). Z-close at 23:55 and Z-open at 00:05 leave a 10-min gap that comfortably exceeds the close command's worst-case wall-clock (Cache::lock + chain verify + audit logging = O(seconds)). stripe:drain-stranded-cpn at every 5 min is bounded by --older-than-minutes=5 predicate so it cannot collide with an in-flight browser flow. sanctum:prune at 04:30 staggers between outbox-prune (04:00) + webhook-prune (04:15) so disk I/O does not spike. Triple-coverage: timezone identical (Europe/Paris) + onOneServer cross-host serialization + withoutOverlapping same-host re-entry guard.

idempotency_at_outbox.idempotency_key_pattern: sha1(event_type | aggregate_id | discriminator?) — listener-specific (PersistOrderCreatedToOutbox.php:23 = one-shot per aggregate; mutation events add discriminator like new_status/new_table_id/payment_status)
idempotency_at_outbox.firstOrCreate_pattern: 12/12 outbox listeners use DomainEvent::firstOrCreate(['idempotency_key' => $key], [...]) — replay-safe at DB layer
idempotency_at_outbox.wasRecentlyCreated_guard: 12/12 listeners check $domainEvent->wasRecentlyCreated to skip afterCommit dispatch on replay (saves queue serialization + log noise; Phase 1 of job would still absorb the dup via dispatched_at lockForUpdate, but this short-circuits earlier). Confirmed across PersistOrderCreatedToOutbox.php:58, PersistOrderTableChangedToOutbox.php:85, PersistOrderPaymentStatusChangedToOutbox.php:70, PersistOrderStatusChangedToOutbox.php:65, PersistCatalogChangedToOutbox.php:92, PersistCouponChangedToOutbox.php:82, PersistSettingsUpdatedToOutbox.php:75, PersistBranchStatusChangedToOutbox.php:80, PersistItemAvailabilityChangedToOutbox.php:89, PersistItemVariationAvailabilityChangedToOutbox.php:65, PersistItemExtraAvailabilityChangedToOutbox.php:66, PersistOrderPaidAtCounterToOutbox.php:54
idempotency_at_outbox.broadcast_layer_idempotency: Phase 1 atomic claim — lockForUpdate + dispatched_at guard + claim mutation form a single committed unit (DispatchDomainEventsJob.php:54-86). The losing worker observes dispatched_at != null after acquiring the lock and returns silently — broadcaster NEVER fires twice for the same row.
idempotency_at_outbox.exactly_once_attempt: Per-row exactly-once-attempt PER dispatch attempt — but on transient failure (Pusher restart), the row's dispatched_at is nulled (Phase 3b, DispatchDomainEventsJob.php:159-165) and the queue retry re-claims. So subscribers may observe duplicates ON RETRY — subscriber idempotency by domain_event_id is REQUIRED.
idempotency_at_outbox.audit_log_replay_idempotency: Replay command writes a fresh 'outbox.replay' audit row per replay event (OutboxRetryFailedCommand.php:120-135) — chain-grows, never overwrites. NF525-safe.

queue_drift_or_polish_items.finding: Worker command drift across 5 docs: QUEUE_TOPOLOGY.md (SSOT, --queue=high,notifications,default) vs PRODUCTION_SETUP.md:60 (--queue=high,default, missing 'notifications') vs DEPLOYMENT_GUIDE_V1.md:80 (no --queue flag) vs DEPLOIEMENT.md:613 (no --queue flag) vs QUEUE_WORKER_SETUP.md:61 (no --queue flag). Risk: operator following the wrong doc spawns a worker that does not drain 'notifications' — FCM sends pile up silently. V1 LOCAL impact = NONE because FCM is optional; V2 SaaS impact = customer push notifications stranded.
queue_drift_or_polish_items.remediation: Doc-polish backlog item: align all 5 docs to QUEUE_TOPOLOGY.md SSOT or add 'see QUEUE_TOPOLOGY.md' redirects in the older docs.

queue_drift_or_polish_items.finding: config/queue.php:16 defaults to env(QUEUE_CONNECTION, 'sync') and .env:20 sets redis, while QUEUE_TOPOLOGY.md §8 checklist prescribes QUEUE_CONNECTION=database. Both drivers are valid for V1 LOCAL; the docs simply lag the env. No P0/P1 impact — the topology contract (lanes, retries, idempotency) is connection-agnostic.
queue_drift_or_polish_items.remediation: Update QUEUE_TOPOLOGY.md §8 checklist to accept {database|redis} or pin one as canonical per environment.

queue_drift_or_polish_items.finding: Ordering guarantee = partial (per-creation enqueue order, BUT multi-worker + retry-on-failure interleaves across aggregates and may even reorder within a single aggregate after a transient Phase 3b throw). No public docs/SUBSCRIBER_CONTRACT.md tells POS/KDS/Kiosk authors 'reconcile by domain_event_id + payload timestamps; do NOT rely on absolute order'. Currently this contract is implicit in DispatchDomainEventsJob.php:30-39 docblock + QUEUE_TOPOLOGY.md §4. Risk: future feature relies on order = broken under V2 scale-out.
queue_drift_or_polish_items.remediation: Write a 1-page SUBSCRIBER_CONTRACT.md or extend QUEUE_TOPOLOGY.md §4 with explicit 'partial ordering + at-least-once' contract.

adversarial_findings.scenario: Queue worker dies mid-job (SIGKILL between Phase 1 claim and Phase 3b release)
adversarial_findings.rationale: OutboxRescueCommand.php:42-44 has a dedicated lane B (whereNotNull(dispatched_at) AND dispatched_at < now()-10min) that releases the stuck claim and re-dispatches. 10-min threshold > worst-case backoff (~6.4 min) + worst observed Pusher hang (~30-60s). Heal B.4 2026-05-19 closed this gap explicitly.
adversarial_findings.residual_risk: If rescue cron is itself down for >10 min AND worker is dead, rows stay orphaned. Mitigated by foodking:outbox:monitor every minute paging humans on stale_count > 10. Compound failure (rescue cron + monitor cron + worker all down simultaneously) requires manual intervention — acceptable for V1 LOCAL single-host.

adversarial_findings.scenario: 1000 events in queue + worker slow → backlog grows → outbox p99 explodes past SLO 2s
adversarial_findings.outcome_observed: PARTIAL — alerting exists, backpressure does not
adversarial_findings.rationale: foodking:outbox:monitor --threshold=10 fires Log::error + non-zero exit when stale_count > 10. QUEUE_TOPOLOGY.md §6 documents 'Pending count high > 100 pendant 2 min' as pager-grade. No automatic backpressure on producers (HTTP layer keeps creating events). With numprocs=2 high-workers (SMB topology), drain rate is bounded — 1000-event burst could take minutes to drain.
adversarial_findings.residual_risk: P1 latent under V2 SaaS scale-out. V1 LOCAL Le Cayenne: traffic is ~50-200 orders/day, multi-event-per-order = peak ~600 events/day. SLO p95 < 2s holds empirically per latest convergence reports. No active blocker.
adversarial_findings.remediation_future: V2 SaaS: add producer-side circuit breaker keyed on jobs-table depth, or scale high-lane workers dynamically (Horizon auto-scaling).

adversarial_findings.scenario: Event ordering — Paid fires before Created arrives at subscriber?
adversarial_findings.rationale: Multi-worker dispatch on the 'high' lane (numprocs=2-4+) can pull two events from the same aggregate concurrently. Phase 1 lockForUpdate serializes the SAME row but does not order across rows. If Event N (Created) hits a transient broadcast failure and goes into 1s backoff, Event N+1 (Paid) can be broadcast first by another worker. Subscriber MUST tolerate out-of-order arrival and reconcile by event_type + payload timestamps + domain_event_id.
adversarial_findings.current_subscriber_handling_evidence: POS/KDS subscribers reconcile via the order's authoritative state (Order.status / Order.payment_status), not by event sequence. KdsOrder contract (project_kds_ultra_plan_2026-05-11.md) explicitly designs around server-state-as-truth. So out-of-order events trigger benign re-render, not data corruption.

adversarial_findings.scenario: Queue cleared accidentally (e.g. operator runs queue:flush in prod) → all in-flight lost?
adversarial_findings.rationale: queue:flush wipes failed_jobs table only — in-flight jobs in the 'jobs' table are untouched. So the actual scenario operators worry about is 'rm jobs table' or 'redis-cli flushall'. After wipe: (a) DispatchDomainEventsJob entries vanish from Redis/DB queue; (b) BUT domain_events table still has the rows with dispatched_at IS NULL; (c) foodking:outbox:rescue cron picks them up within 1 min and re-dispatches. So worst-case data loss window = 1 min after a queue wipe.
adversarial_findings.remediation_already_in_place: OUTBOX TABLE IS THE SOURCE OF TRUTH. Queue is just transport. This is the entire point of the outbox pattern + rescue cron design (Kernel.php:40-43 docblock).

adversarial_findings.scenario: Contract violation flood — buggy producer emits 1000 events with malformed payload, would normally consume 6000 high-lane messages (6 tries each)
adversarial_findings.rationale: PayloadMismatchException short-circuits via $this->fail() in DispatchDomainEventsJob.php:182-186 (F-3 SYNC P1 V1.0.1 quick win 2026-05-19). Single attempt per bad event → failed_jobs + last_error with 'contract_violation:' prefix. Sentinel: tests/Feature/Sentinels/PayloadMismatchFailOnceSentinelTest.php.

adversarial_findings.scenario: Chronic-failure flapping — pre-Heal B.1 the OutboxRetryFailedCommand wiped attempts=0 every run, so a chronically failing row flapped indefinitely + never crossed prune threshold (attempts>=6).
adversarial_findings.rationale: Heal B.1 Z3 B-2 P0 (2026-05-19) made attempts MONOTONIC + added REPLAY_MAX_ATTEMPTS=12 ceiling (OutboxRetryFailedCommand.php:67). Rows at/above cap left alone — staleness monitor still pages, prune lane (90d + attempts>=6) eventually reclaims.

adversarial_findings.scenario: Two admins (or cron + manual) fire foodking:outbox:retry-failed in the same minute — double-write audit_logs + double-dispatch.
adversarial_findings.rationale: Cache::lock 'outbox.retry-failed.lock' TTL 300s (OutboxRetryFailedCommand.php:42-46, Wave 3b SYNC-ADV3B-06 P1 2026-05-18). Released in `finally` so an early throw never strands the key. Second invocation: warns + Log info + exits SUCCESS.

adversarial_findings.scenario: Broadcast layer (Pusher/Soketi) silently dies — workers keep broadcasting into the void; outbox stays green-emerald.
adversarial_findings.rationale: DispatchDomainEventsJob.php:128-132 stamps ws:heartbeat cache key on EVERY successful broadcast (GOAL-CMS-2026-05-18 S-P0-A heal R1 SRE-001). SyncOverviewController:531 reads it. Without this, the admin observability dashboard would have stayed green while Pusher died silently. 120s TTL > 4× per-surface polling.

adversarial_findings.scenario: Observability listener (EscalateOutboxBroadcastSwallowed) throws and re-breaks the cascade.
adversarial_findings.rationale: Listener is synchronous (NOT ShouldQueue) — fires inside the originating listener's DB::afterCommit hook (EscalateOutboxBroadcastSwallowed.php:33-39 docblock). PersistOrderCreatedToOutbox.php:98-103 nests an extra try/catch absorbing observability failure — 'observability MUST NOT itself re-break the cascade'. Defense-in-depth confirmed.

DispatchDomainEventsJob.php:30-39 — single source of truth for retry curve rationale (Audit T G2)
Kernel.php — single source of truth for cron schedules
verdict_rationale: Outbox dispatch pipeline is production-grade for V1 LOCAL Le Cayenne. Retry envelope correct (tries=6 + curve 1/5/15/60/300 = ~6.4 min, deliberately calibrated to outlast Pusher restart). Dead-letter strategy = in-table attempts/last_error + automated DLQ replay cron (hourly, 24h window, lock-guarded, batch-capped, attempt-capped, audit-trailed) + 90d prune. Idempotency triple-layered: DB UNIQUE(idempotency_key) + listener firstOrCreate + Phase 1 atomic claim under row lock. All 4 mission-specified crons (stripe:drain-stranded-cpn / sanctum:prune-expired / z:close-safety-net / z:open-safety-net) present with proper onOneServer + withoutOverlapping + non-conflicting timezones. Adversarial scenarios A01-A09 all mitigated by existing heals (B.1 / B.2 / B.4 / F-3 / NEW-03 / Audit T G2/G3 / Wave 3b/3c / WJ-4). Ordering guarantee = partial (per-creation enqueue + per-row exactly-once-attempt), which is correct semantics for an at-least-once distributed outbox + V1 LOCAL traffic; subscribers already reconcile by server-state-as-truth. Three P3 doc-polish items (Z10-D-01/02/03) — non-blocking. No P0/P1 findings. No frozen-zone touch in this audit (read-only).
nf525_impact: none — outbox is OPERATIONAL, audit_logs + z_reports untouched and explicitly excluded from prune (PruneOutboxCommand.php:25-27)
